one_line: Cloud commerce platform whose Admin API (REST + GraphQL) lets you manage stores, products, orders, customers, and apps.
auth_notes: Public/custom apps use OAuth2 (client id/secret, scopes) to obtain an access token sent as X-Shopify-Access-Token header; admin-generated custom apps use admin-authenticated tokens; scopes requested at install.
self_serve_notes: Free Partner/dev store + free Shopify development store; any dev can create an app in the Dev Dashboard and get OAuth credentials without paying.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Hundreds of endpoints across Admin REST (~50 resources) and Admin GraphQL (products, orders, customers, inventory, fulfillment, metafields, marketing, payments, plus B2B); also Storefront API, Payments, Marketplaces, Bulk operations
api_surface.webhook_note: Full webhook subsystem (products/orders/customers/fulfillments etc.) delivered to HTTPS endpoints; GraphQL webhooks with filterable topics

existing_mcp.note: Official Shopify MCP server exists (Shopify/mcp, supports Admin GraphQL); several community MCP servers also published

evidence.note: Fetched text confirms GraphQL Admin API endpoint, OAuth access tokens, scopes, cost-based rate limits (shopify.dev/docs/api/admin); REST/webhooks/MCP from platform knowledge

agent_notes: Auth is OAuth with scopes; free dev store makes it fully self-serve. Very broad and well documented.
